descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**Sportvida CyberDash** is a **VR running game** that delivers both stress relief and thrilling challenges. Set in a high-speed, futuristic world of light and technology, you’ll embark on an intense adventure where **sprinting, dodging, and smashing obstacles** offer an unparalleled sense of release.
[media]


Your mission is to race to the finish line in the shortest time possible, breaking through anything that stands in your way. **Whether you're a fitness enthusiast or simply seeking stress relief, this game will help you find your rhythm and rediscover joy in movement.**

[media]
# 💥3 Unique Game Modes:
- Race Mode – Pure running with no speed limits and no obstacles—push yourself to the max and challenge your top speed!

[media]
- Dodge Mode – Dodge randomly generated obstacles for a unique experience every time—test your reflexes!

[media]
- Strike Mode – Sprint when the path is clear, strike or dodge when obstacles appear—balance challenge and endurance!

[media]


# 🏃‍♂️Stress-Free Running: 

In the light-speed world of SPORTVIDA, run freely and smash through obstacles! It’s the ultimate way to relieve stress, **challenging yourself while enjoying the thrill of high-speed excitement.**
[media]

# 💪Casual Fitness: 
Sweat it out in-game and make fitness fun! **Remember to warm up before starting, grab your towel, and get ready for an exciting workout challenge!**
[media]
